title: Shopify Product Photos That Match Your Store | Aidreamcapes
description: Create Shopify product photos with AI: matching square images for collection pages, lifestyle shots for product pages and short videos. Start with one photo.
h1: Shopify Product Photos and Videos From One Upload
lead: Give each product page a matching set of square photos, a lifestyle shot or two, and a short clip, all starting from a picture you already took.
secondary_keywords: product photos for a Shopify store
intro: A Shopify store looks more polished when every product photo feels like it came from the same shoot. Mixed backgrounds and odd crops make a collection page look unfinished, even when the products themselves are great. Aidreamcapes helps you even things out: upload the photos you have, choose a clean background or describe a setting, and get square images that sit neatly side by side.

Product pages also need something that keeps shoppers scrolling. Add a lifestyle photo, such as a throw blanket on a reading chair or a water bottle in a gym bag, and a 6, 10 or 15-second video in 1:1 or 16:9 for the media gallery. Everything stays private in your account until you download it and add it in your Shopify admin.
tips: Use the same shape for every product photo in a collection so the grid lines up neatly.
Put your clearest, simplest photo first, because it's usually the one shown on collection pages.
Write short alt text for each image so shoppers using screen readers know what's pictured.

ideas.d: Give every candle, mug or tee in a collection the same plain background so the page reads as one set.

ideas.t: Lifestyle shot for the product page
ideas.d: Add a photo of the item where it's used, like a planter on a sunny windowsill, right after the main image.

ideas.t: Short clip in the media gallery
ideas.d: A 10-second video of the product being handled gives shoppers a closer look than a still can.

faq.q: What size should Shopify product photos be?
faq.a: Shopify accepts several shapes; what matters most is keeping them consistent. Our photos are square by default, which keeps collection pages tidy.

faq.q: Can I add a video to my Shopify product page?
faq.a: Yes, Shopify product media supports video. Make a 1:1 or 16:9 clip, download it, and upload it in the product's media section.

faq.q: Will all my product photos look consistent?
faq.a: Describing the same background each time helps a lot. Results can still vary slightly, so review each image before it goes on your store.
